question:
I started my first Premier League season by scoring a hat-trick in August and winning Player of the Month.
Unfortunately I was unable to prevent my club from being relegated that year.
I've been managed by Daniel Farke, Dean Smith & Thomas Frank

style.why: The hook is strong and memorable (hat-trick + Player of the Month in August), and the tension of being relegated despite that performance fits the style guide perfectly. The manager list works well to narrow it down without giving away the name immediately. It reads naturally and feels like a story.
style.fix: Consider adding a slight emotional beat or consequence to the relegation sentence to match the 'feeling' in the best originals (e.g., 'It was a bitter pill, as I couldn't prevent...'), but it is already very close to a 5.
